name: head-agent-core
description: Provider-neutral HEAD coordination for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode with reproducible Context Capsules and evidence-linked Execution Lineage contracts.

interface.longDescription: A provider-neutral HEAD core with explicit authority boundaries, deterministic Context Capsules, review-gated product onboarding, contract-bound Runs, evidence-linked Result Packets, and auditable Execution Lineage.
capabilities: Verified Git-backed Claude Code Marketplace Distribution
Risk-proportional Observe Session Run and Authority Routing
Canonical Session and Run Compaction Recovery
Bounded Fully-verified World Model Status Projection
Debounced Filesystem and CI Refresh Triggers
Native Worker Integrity and Lifecycle Checks
Local JSON and In-memory Graph Projection
Exact-target Missing Database Provision and Incompatible Reset
Snapshot-scoped ArcadeDB Vertex and Edge Topology
Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode Projection-only Runtime Adapters
Windows, macOS, and Linux Platform Contract Matrix
Idempotent Send Read and Immutable Reply
Exact Endpoint WorkspaceHost Attachment and Delivery
Privacy-preserving Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode CLI Discovery
HEAD Project and Session Runtime Capability Binding
Claude Code Non-persistent Structured One-shot Adapter
Claude Code Permission and Tool Boundary Projection
Bounded Runtime Event and ResultPacket Draft Schemas
defaultPrompt: Initialize this project for HEAD coordination.
Index this project and prepare an evidence-linked onboarding candidate batch without changing Product Canon.
Configure a project-relative source scope before onboarding so generated copies, bundled third-party code, and other user-selected roots remain outside product inference.
Review the current onboarding candidate batch before promoting any product concepts.
Compile the minimum sufficient context for this task.
Create a verifiable whole-plan execution lineage.
Run one accepted Execution Contract and review its Result Packet.
Inspect task-relevant Git decision evidence without promoting it to canon.
Inspect a bounded derived projection of the user-owned Product Model without changing canon.
Inspect content-addressed File, Symbol, and Test revisions through a bounded temporal graph query.
Inspect the current graph projection adapter and verify it remains a rebuildable non-authoritative materialized view.
Audit the selected ArcadeDB database for HEAD-reserved schema compatibility before explicit initialization or activation.
Generate or inspect deterministic Markdown knowledge projections without treating documents as canon.
Capture edited generated Markdown as review-required DocumentChangeCandidates without changing Product Canon.
Review a DocumentChangeCandidateSet with an explicit complete Product Model, then apply it through a digest-verifiable Canon, GraphSnapshot, and Markdown receipt.
Configure or inspect safe post-refresh Markdown projection without overwriting edited documents.
Refresh observed repository state incrementally while preserving active Run inputs and immutable snapshot ancestry.
Coalesce filesystem or CI observations into a bounded refresh trigger batch without trusting path hints or changing Product Canon.
Inspect onboarding review and promotion receipts; include unreviewed candidates only when explicitly requested.
Infer Feature-to-code mapping candidates, then require explicit review before creating IMPLEMENTS or VERIFIED_BY relationships.
Record an accepted execution as a Git-independent ChangeSet, then review inferred Feature or Capability impact before creating IMPACTS relationships.
Attach explicitly selected Git commits as optional evidence without changing the provider-neutral ChangeSet identity.
Label product learning as a non-persisted observed fact, hypothesis, or inferred meaning, and persist it only when a handoff, audit, product-state, or cross-Run boundary requires recovery.
Recommend the lightest safe Observe, Session, Run, or Authority lane without creating authority or project artifacts.
Propose a Product Initiative from inline reasoning and defer Feature resolution until explicit review without changing Product Canon.
Review a Product Initiative explicitly, then bind OutcomeObservation evidence to an accepted ChangeSet without judging Feature success.
Inspect the on-demand HEAD continuity snapshot as a derived exact-reference view, never as recovery canon.
Prepare, verify, and continue an intentional lossy provider compaction from a canonical Session or Run checkpoint without treating the provider summary as authority.
Restore the exact current Session consumer input from verified artifacts without resuming a provider session.
Restore P2 first, then optionally verify one exact live HEAD attachment; fall back to a disclosed fresh logical HEAD without persisting provider session identity.
Dispatch one registered non-HEAD worker against an exact Run authorization, observe only P5 progress, and reject competing ownership or duplicate consumption.
Apply a completed actual-provider worker result only into ResultPacket plus Fresh HEAD review context before separate accept and checkpoint integration.
After an accepted Fresh HEAD review, bind one reviewed Run result to one explicit recovery checkpoint without letting worker evidence author the next direction.
Exchange durable role messages through a trusted host binding without allowing messages to replace ExecutionContracts, ReviewDecisions, or Product Canon.
Attach a trusted host-injected caller to an exact live role endpoint and require fresh target, acknowledgment, and post-send evidence before reporting delivery.

Wake one exact current offline-registered role binding through a provider-neutral claimed host request, then require the started provider to prove its own binding and process proof before reading or replying.
Have an already-running worker ask HEAD an authority question and boundedly wait for a non-authoritative reply without creating a ReviewDecision.
Interrupt or close only one exact owned one-shot provider tree while keeping resume and stream disabled.
Inspect external runtime observations without granting runtime control authority.

Inspect the Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode runtime adapter contract, read-only discovery, bounded version and protocol capability evidence, and HEAD project/Session binding without creating, resuming, streaming, interrupting, or closing a provider session.
Prepare an ExecutionContract-bound runtime invocation authorization without starting a provider, then inspect its digest-verifiable project, Session, Run, input, and resource boundaries.
Inspect whether one runtime invocation authorization is available, actively consumed, incompletely consumed, or durably released without replaying it.
Inspect the current HEAD session and Context Capsule.
